content.text:
The trigger only fires on **insert**, not update — so updating `auth.users` won't call it.

In `apps/docs/content/_partials/user_management_quickstart_sql_template.mdx`:
```sql
create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute procedure public.handle_new_user();
```

To sync updates too, add a companion trigger with `after update on auth.users` (and adjust `handle_new_user()` to do an upsert/update into `public.profiles` instead of only `insert`). See `apps/docs/content/guides/auth/managing-user-data.mdx` ("Using triggers") for the pattern.
